limitations: centre-rules/1 is Tutorwell's own test rule, modelled on common tutoring and writing-centre policies; it is not any centre's actual policy.
Tutorwell enforces the centre's rules only; consent to share accommodations, the type of work and the choice of skill are checked by graders from the activity log.
The GUI is a read-only reviewer renderer with four views; there is no interactive business Web App or tutor-side interface.
One student account per App instance; no payment, waitlists, video sessions, tutoring dialogue or live sync with any product.
